[P2] Return the untested error guards to the design phase

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” remains unsatisfied. Both test parametrizations use the helper that raises `HELPER_FAILURE`; neither exercises a different error message or an unexpected successful return. Removing either defensive rejection leaves the test results unchanged, so these failure paths have no regression protection. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and decide whether these cases need meaningful coverage or whether the fixed fixture permits a simpler approach.
